subject.title: Feature Request: cron.defaults.delivery config for default delivery target

question: When a detached cron job omits an announce destination, should OpenClaw inherit an operator-configured recipient, require explicit job routing, or run silently?
rationale: This choice determines whether unattended output can be disclosed to an inherited recipient or lost by suppression, and neighboring pull requests advocate incompatible defaults.

options.title: Opt-in configured recipient
options.body: Add a narrow cron channel and recipient default that fills omitted announce destinations while preserving explicit per-job overrides.

options.title: Require explicit job routing
options.body: Diagnose announce jobs without a concrete destination and keep recipient selection entirely job-local.

options.title: Silent when omitted
options.body: Run detached jobs without delivery unless each job explicitly opts into announcement routing.

recommendation.title: Opt-in configured recipient
recommendation.body: Add a narrow cron channel and recipient default that fills omitted announce destinations while preserving explicit per-job overrides.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the clearest available connection to the current delivery/config snapshot and already supplied product-triage context on this issue.
